newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's Inc says files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's Inc says files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Grossman's Inc and two affiliates Monday filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, the court spokeswoman confirmed.
The two affiliates, which also filed for Chapter 11 protection were GRS Holding Co Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Grossman's, and GRS Realty Co Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of GRS Holding Co.
In a year end financial statement dated March 31, Grossman's said it had a "severe liquidity problem and an imminent plan to file for Chapter 11 protection from creditors."
Grossman's is scheduled for a hearing on Tuesday at which the company will file motions to allow it to continue normal business operations.
The case has been assigned to U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Peter Walsh.
No other information is available at this time about the bankruptcy filing.
